title: A plaza
content: This is my 3-4 visit here and every time it has a giant shopping district that I never really look at, but there is two areas I frequent most. A magician that has a bird of some kind I think it’s a parrot, and then a area that has a big open space with a long row of seating but it’s like a giant block of concrete that is a horizontal arc (I don’t know what it is called).
